apps.name: Laya
apps.subtitle: Music player with lyrics, karaoke and Listen Together.
apps.localizedDescription: Laya is a music player with synced lyrics, on-device karaoke, Listen Together, Atmos-style reverb and home-screen widgets.

versions.localizedDescription:
- **Landscape support.** Rotate your iPhone; pages, the tab bar and the mini player stay clear of the notch and Dynamic Island. No more white flash while rotating.
- **Several Google accounts.** Add, switch between and remove accounts, including Brand profiles, from the Account page. Your existing sign-in carries over.
- **App icon picker** in Settings: Default, Liquid Glass and Liquid Glass Dark (real glass on iOS 26).
- **Artist header video**, as on Android, when animated canvas is on.
- **Follow artists and save releases** from their pages; Library updates right away.
- **Liked Music and long playlists** now load in full, not just the first 100 songs.
- **Quality upgrades mid-song** swap in without stopping playback, and the player menu has Upgrade quality and Revert to original.
- **Lock screen controls** (play, pause, seek, next, previous) now work with Listen Together, and the lock screen no longer stays on Pause after you stop.
- **Listen Together** stays in sync after the phone has been locked, and track changes no longer jump to the previous song's position.
- Song and player menus: no more bouncing while scrolling; album and artist links work for more songs, and the player closes before opening a page.
- Spotify connects through the in-app sign-in page only.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Laya saves your Replay and lyrics cards to your photo library when you tap Save.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Laya finds Chromecasts and Google Cast speakers on your Wi-Fi so you can play music on them.
